correctness.rationale: The positive definite killed cycle Laplacian has an entrywise nonnegative symmetric inverse. Summing the killed Poisson equation yields κ sum(trap values)=n; central-vertex pair averages along each trap gap give lower bound n/(rκ)+(2r)^{-1} sum floor(gap²/4), and discrete convexity gives its minimum at common gap q=n/r. Equally spaced symmetry yields explicit u= q/κ+j(q−j)/2 and attains equality. Independently checked 516 exact-rational and 17,274 numerical linear systems; checks do not establish infinite cases.

value.rationale: Provides the exact natural operator stability/maximum expected lifetime minimax for every divisible cycle size, trap count and every positive killing strength. The κ-independent geometric gap cost separates imperfect absorption from travel delay and explains equal-spacing optimality beyond the well-known perfect-trap limit; a nontrivial all-placement result rather than a small-instance tabulation. Quantifiers, limitation to commensurate lengths, and no uniqueness claim are explicit.
